g.text: CI flags this box: the word is wider

svg.text: Everything the event shows, in Finnish (D14)
The organiser shell, every module's pages, every screen word and Moments' built-in stories;
<html lang> follows the language. Each person may keep their own language for their pages.
CI shoots every screen in both languages; a check flags text wider than its box. Finnish runs
about a third longer than English.
One catalog per module: i18n/en.json and i18n/fi.json, ICU plurals.
screen: 2 keys added in this PR without Finnish (studio.devices.forget_title,
studio.devices.forget_body). The check fails the PR; at runtime a missing key falls back to
docs/i18n/glossary.md fixes the words once: zone = alue, screen = näyttö, run of show =
ohjelma, moment = hetki; plain spoken Finnish, short verbs on buttons.
Each PR that adds an English string adds its Finnish one; the product owner reads the first
